mapper.sql: (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(R.ROLE_NM ORDER BY R.SORT_NO SEPARATOR ', ') FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID) AS ROLE_NMS , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID AND R.ROLE_CD = 'SUPER') AS SUPER_CNT , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(CAST(U.ROLE_SQ AS CHAR)) FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID) AS ROLE_SQS
mapper.select: SELECT E.EMPLY_SQ, E.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_EMAIL, E.EMPLY_PH_NUM, E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD , IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN, IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN, E.PW_INIT_YN , DATE_FORMAT(E.LAST_LOGIN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, LEFT(E.EMPLY_REG_DT, 10) AS REG_DT , S.STAFF_SQ, S.STATUS_CD AS STAFF_STATUS, S.STAFF_NM , FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID ORDER BY E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_SQ
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, COMPANY_EMAIL, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STATUS_CD = 'WORK' AND IFNULL(EMPLY_ID, '') = '' ORDER BY STAFF_NM

SELECT E.EMPLY_SQ, E.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, E.EMPLY_EMAIL, E.EMPLY_PH_NUM, E.EMPLY_HOME_ADDR, E.EMPLY_SEX_TYP_CD, E.EMPLY_RRN, E.EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD , IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') AS USE_YN, IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') AS DEL_YN, E.PW_INIT_YN , DATE_FORMAT(E.LAST_LOGIN_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS LAST_LOGIN_DT, LEFT(E.EMPLY_REG_DT, 10) AS REG_DT , S.STAFF_SQ, S.STATUS_CD AS STAFF_STATUS, S.STAFF_NM , FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E LEFT JOIN TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M S ON S.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID WHERE E.EMPLY_SQ = #{sq}
SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, COMPANY_EMAIL, PHONE, STATUS_CD, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{staffSq}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} AND EMPLY_SQ <> #{EMPLY_SQ}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_EMPLY_M (EMPLY_ID, EMPLY_PW, EMPLY_NM, EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD, EMPLY_PH_NUM, EMPLY_EMAIL, USE_YN, DEL_YN, PW_INIT_YN, EMPLY_REG_DT) VALUES (#{EMPLY_ID}, #{EMPLY_PW}, #{EMPLY_NM}, #{TYPE_CD}, #{EMPLY_PH_NUM,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{EMPLY_EMAIL,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', 'N', #{PW_INIT_YN}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{OLD_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{OLD_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_PW = #{EMPLY_PW}, PW_INIT_YN = 'Y', EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{EMPLY_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_AUTH_TYP_CD = #{TYPE_CD}, EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{EMPLY_SQ}
UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ} AND IFNULL(EMPLY_ID, '') = ''
mapper.select: SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, RRN_ENC, COMPANY_EMAIL, PHONE, ADDR, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, STATUS_CD, EMPLY_ID FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STAFF_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COMPANY_EMAIL LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR REPLACE(PHONE, '-', '') LIKE CONCAT('%', REPLACE(#{keyword}, '-', ''), '%') ORDER BY STATUS_CD = 'WORK' DESC, STAFF_NM, STAFF_SQ LIMIT 20

SELECT STAFF_SQ, STAFF_NM, RRN_ENC, ORG_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, EMPLY_ID , REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(JOIN_DT, '-', ''), '.', ''), '/', '') AS JOIN_KEY FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STATUS_CD = 'WORK' AND TRIM(STAFF_NM) = #{NAME} AND REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(PHONE, '-', ''), ' ', ''), '.', '') = #{PHONE} ORDER BY STAFF_SQ LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE LOWER(TRIM(COMPANY_EMAIL)) = #{EMAIL} AND STAFF_SQ <> #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET COMPANY_EMAIL = #{EMAIL} WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{STAFF_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT RRN_ENC FROM TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M WHERE STAFF_SQ = #{staffSq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_HR_STAFF_M SET EMPLY_ID = NULL WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.select: SELECT EMPLY_PW FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
SELECT SECRET_YN FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{sq}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET SECRET_YN = #{SECRET_YN} WHERE EMPLY_SQ = #{EMPLY_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT EMPLY_SQ FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET EMPLY_PW = #{EMPLY_PW}, PW_INIT_YN = 'N', EMPLY_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID}
UPDATE TB_EEP_EMPLY_M SET LAST_LOGIN_DT = NOW() WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT E.EMPLY_EMAIL FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ AND R.ROLE_CD = 'SUPER' JOIN TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E ON E.EMPLY_ID = U.EMPLY_ID WHERE IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' AND E.EMPLY_EMAIL LIKE '%_@_%'
